summary: BigSeed is an agent skill for personal life-note and fleeting-thought capture, helping organize fragments into a user profile and generate story-style outputs like novels, scripts, or autobiographies.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin is best classified as a memory-context tool because its stated purpose is to capture personal moments and thoughts, build a user-centric profile, and generate autobiographical or story-form outputs. Evidence from the repository description and README explicitly frames it as a DeepSeek Harness agent skill for journals/life stories, and package metadata confirms it is a DSH plugin with an execution bundle, so the core user-facing value is personal memory organization and narrative generation.
